args.body: Finish the existing CATALOGUE-FIXED-PRICE-DELIVERY-TRIAL under a valid lease and reuse a completed verdict if present. TASK-179585676100 shows a third failed check, utf8_no_bom_lf_only. Run the actual verifier on a version of the same modified fixture that preserves the clean control's serialization while changing only the barcode and variant image cells. Compare the failed-check lists. If the formatting check clears, record the original fixture artifact and use the isolated control for the buyer report. If it persists, report the observed check and inspect the bytes before naming a cause. Confirm both manual row locations by SKU, keep the CAD 60 decision provisional and leave unmeasured all-in effort unknown. Read back the final evidence and close with a lesson. Keep the report private.

description: The 20-row fictional catalogue trial passed its clean control and flagged three checks in the modified control. The draft report locates the barcode and image differences, but omits the failed UTF-8/BOM/LF check. The latest served-page receipt and pinned catalogue also conflict with the earlier homepage object ID cited in the handoff. Verify the actual bytes and isolate the formatting failure before closing the trial or changing the offer. CAD 60 remains provisional because all-in effort is unknown. Five sources remain unclassified, and Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
